verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for an open-source agent infrastructure tool, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence mentions telemetry, usage tracking, analytics, or any way to disable them. End-to-end encryption, one-command uninstall, and 'no account needed' are related privacy features, not a telemetry opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
